latest_substantive_result.summary: The source reports a global all-amplitude H1 path inequality for a selected known-input -B to +B transfer under explicit positive spatial and scalar-curvature margins, plus an exact reset obstruction to nonuniform patterns under the same connected one-dimensional amplitude cap. Refined synthetic cycles report T=2 failure and T=20/T=100 success; the single unoptimized direct pulse is cheaper at T=20 and costlier at T=100 with unmatched peak resources. A separate typed four-junction graph reports jam probability 8424/30125 at synthetic k/nu=1; the untyped model has a different transition set and a distinct probability. A source correction sets external terminal voltages to zero during hold. Molecular geometry, rates, retention, experiment, independent correctness, novelty and practical advantage remain UNKNOWN.
